interfaceBody: Which language would you like for the app and this introduction? Choose another language or keep the current one.
translationBody: Choose a translation language for meanings and examples. It can differ from the interface language. You can also turn translations off.
secondaryMention: You can add a second translation language later in Settings → Languages.
startBody: Start or continue an available word training to explore its real cards. If there are no cards yet, configure the training or return to the Library topic.
revealBody: Select Show answer to turn the card over and see its definition and examples.
exitBody: Your learning action is saved. Close the session to finish the introduction and choose further topics.
libraryBody: Library lets you find words and choose the meanings you want to practise.
meaningBody: This word can have several meanings. Choose the one you need: only that meaning is added to a collection.
collectionsBody: Open Collections for this meaning. Collections group selected meanings; they do not copy or reset learning progress.
membershipTitle: The meaning is in your collection
membershipBody: The checked collection contains this meaning. Choose Done to continue; the meaning keeps its learning progress.
goTrainingTitle: Make a training for the collection
goTrainingBody: Return to Training. A collection selects material; a saved training also remembers how you practise it.
createTrainingBody: Create a separate training for your collection. Your existing trainings remain available.
sourceBody: Open Source to choose your collection instead of the whole dictionary.
exercisesBody: Open Exercises. For this first collection training, keep Words and choose Direct.
directionBody: Choose Direct. You see the word first and recall its meaning. Reverse starts with the meaning.
saveTrainingBody: Save the training so you can return to the collection and these exercise settings.
nameTrainingBody: Enter a recognisable name and save. This creates a separate saved training, not a new copy of learning progress.
audioBody: Click the speaker to hear the word. Then explore its other meanings.
detailsBody: This card shows one meaning. Click the three dots to open the dictionary entry with all available meanings.
returnBody: Expand the meanings you want to read. Close this panel to return to the training card.
knownTitle: If you already know the meaning
knownBody: “Mark as known” is an alternative to “Learn” for a meaning you already know. It applies to this meaning, not every meaning of the word.
reportBody: The flag button (Report) opens a problem report for translations, card content or application behaviour. Open it to explore the form.
paused: Tour paused. Resume in Settings → Getting started.
pauseIntro: You can pause the introduction and find it again in Settings → Getting started. After reloading, it resumes from the beginning of the current topic.
collectionsTopic: Library, collection and your own training
basicDoneBody: You have chosen your languages and tried a card. Explore more topics now, or return later in Settings → Getting started.
statsViewBody: This panel shows learning directions, card presentations and reviews. Close it with the cross to continue.
appearanceChoiceBody: This is where you change the application’s appearance. Choose light, dark or system theme.
sharingTabBody: In Library, select the Collections tab.
sharingMoreBody: Select the three dots to the right of your collection.
sharingMenuBody: This opens sharing settings for the selected collection.
sharingConfirmBody: Read the invitation link/code warning and confirm.
sharingCopyLinkBody: Cards are shared through a collection. Select Copy link to send it to another person.
sharingCopyCodeTitle: You can share a code too
sharingCopyCodeBody: An invitation code is an alternative to a link. Select Copy code.
sharingSentTitle: The invitation is ready to send
sharingSentBody: Send the link or code however you prefer. The collection remains available until you close shared access. Close this panel.
incomingSharedBody: Select the Shared tab in Library.
incomingReceivedBody: This is where shared collections you have added appear. Select Added by me.
incomingAddBody: Select Add by link / code to connect cards shared with you.
incomingPreviewBody: Check the name and card samples. View only means the owner manages the collection while you can view and practise. Select Add to library.
incomingAcceptedBody: The collection is now in your library. Click “View words” to open its cards.
themeShortcutBody: This button on the main screens cycles through light, dark and system themes. Select it to try.
themeShortcutDoneBody: Keep selecting it to explore all three modes. System theme follows your device. You do not need to open Appearance each time.
wordBody: This is the current word or question. Try to recall its meaning before revealing the answer.
answerBody: The back of the card shows the meaning and examples. Each meaning is learned separately.
liveLearnBody: For a new card, click Learn. If you have studied it before, rate how well you recalled the answer. This updates your actual learning progress.
liveOpenWordBody: The search is already prepared. Open a word and expand the meaning you want to study.
liveMembershipBody: Select an existing collection, or create a named collection here. Wait until the meaning is added, then continue.
liveSourceBody: Choose your collection as the training material. Then continue to configure the exercises.
liveSharingCreateBody: Create a view-only invitation for this collection. Review the confirmation: people with the link or code can subscribe and forward it.
liveInvitationBody: Paste a real invitation link or code you received, then check it. Adding a collection happens only after you confirm its preview.
liveReportBody: This is the normal error report form. You can fill and submit a report if needed, or close it. Continue when you have finished looking.
liveStatsBody: Click New or Learning above this meaning. Progress is tracked separately for each meaning and direction.
topicDoneBody: You have finished this topic. You can return to the introduction and other topics in Settings → Getting started.
waiting: This action is not available on the current screen yet. Finish the open dialog or wait for loading. You can pause and return from Settings → Getting started.
storageError: Could not save your place on this device. The guide can continue, but may not resume after reloading.
deviceHint: Your place in the guide is saved on this device. Closing tips keeps your collections and learning progress.
returnTrainingBody: Return to Training using the highlighted navigation button.
